articles.title: Flyers Activate Barkey Off IR; Place Grebenkin on IR
Nuts & Bolts: Lightning host Caps in home opener

out.detail: placed on injured reserve with an upper-body injury

away.summary: The Flyers (0-1-2) are on a four-game-in-six-nights stretch to start the season, coming off a 3-2 overtime loss to Carolina where Joseph Woll delivered another strong goaltending performance. They activated Denver Barkey off IR and placed Nikita Grebenkin on IR with an upper-body injury, while Rasmus Ristolainen remains out with an upper-body injury suffered Saturday. The team continues to struggle with chance creation and shot volume, being outchanced 59-22 and outshot 41-22 per game through three contests.

home.summary: The Lightning (1-1-0) enter this game off a solid 3-1 home win over the Washington Capitals, with Jake Guentzel contributing a goal and two assists and Andrei Vasilevskiy stopping 20 of 21 shots. They will be without defenseman Emil Lilleberg (about a week out), forward Dominic James (hand injury), and forward Yanni Gourde (hip). Andrei Vasilevskiy is confirmed to start in goal.
